## Objective
- Continue from the existing project and finish the game as a complete, playable build.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Treated the existing Earth Core Miner / CORELINE project as the game to finish; it already contains a 3D mining-site exploration and drilling progression loop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected the existing game files and confirmed `game.js` passes `node --check`.
- Started the project with `./start.sh`; capture verified the welcome screen renders.
- Captured and inspected a started-game JPEG at `/tmp/opencode/started.jpg`; the start button hides the welcome screen.

### Active
- Assess gameplay for issues and make any necessary changes to complete/polish the game.

### Blocked
- No known blockers.

## Next Move
1. Test the interaction/gameplay loop (movement, shop, oil refill, drilling, upgrades, progression, completion) and fix any discovered issues.
2. Run syntax and browser checks, capture a current JPEG at viewport ≤1280px, and inspect it.
3. Summarize changes and assumptions when finished.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: existing Three.js game world, player controls, interactions, economy, drilling progression, and HUD updates.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: game UI, HUD, welcome screen, and module entry point.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: game and interface styling.

## Important Context
- No source files have been modified yet; the working tree was clean when checked.
- `./capture.sh` requires `CAPTURE_URL` and `CAPTURE_DIR`; successful capture command was `CAPTURE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 CAPTURE_DIR=/tmp/opencode/cap CAPTURE_AUTO_START=false ./capture.sh`.
- The started-game check used `DISPLAY=:0` and saved `/tmp/opencode/started.jpg`.

- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them upon completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) and inspect only the latest.

- Continue with the existing 3D mining-site exploration and drilling progression game.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed `game.js` passes `node --check`.
- Started the project and verified the welcome screen and start button in the browser.
- Verified movement changes the player position.
- With browser-only debug instrumentation, verified buying an oil drum, refilling the rig, starting the drill, and purchasing a power upgrade.

### Active
- Test and fix the complete gameplay loop: drilling layer progression, rewards, upgrades, resupply, and mission completion.
- Run final syntax and browser checks, capture and inspect the latest JPEG.

### Blocked
- Progression verification is unresolved: the attempted automated test did not advance strata because its debug call passed invalid timing data; later upgrade checks then ran out of funds.

## Next Move
1. Rerun layer progression tests with valid elapsed-time input and confirm resources/rewards and upgrade affordability.
2. Fix any discovered gameplay issues in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`.
3. Recheck syntax and gameplay in the browser, then capture and inspect a current JPEG at viewport ≤1280px.
